name: six-face-full-run
description: The DEFAULT six-face run in policy mode, with zero timed inputs: hold fire, hold right while the world is scrolling, back off (the scroll is frozen, so retreating is free) while a wave gate's message is up and there is daylight to the damage plane, hop on every landing, and dodge a houndframe the moment it plants for its charge. Everything is position- or state-triggered because a 100+ second run's event times move with every tuning change — the case the README's policy mode exists for. WHERE IT STOPS, AND WHY — MEASURED, NOT ASPIRATIONAL (re-measured 2026-08-01 on task/T-009 merged up to main b23184b, i.e. with the T-013 shell and the T-014 mortar in the tree; 150 s cap, --deterministic, 1440x900): this policy clears wave gate 1, crosses face 2 picking up weapons on the way, reaches the second corner's pivot (maxX 154.3, scroll 140 of 415) with 11 kills and 48.5 s of PLAYING time, spends its third life inside wave gate 2 ('WAVE 2/6 — 7 HOSTILES') and ends in GAME_OVER. It does NOT reach VICTORY, and no run of it ever has. The three lives go at x 31.6, x 93.0 and x 148.0 — all three inside gate fights, none of them in a pocket or on a traversal gap. IT IS NOT THE LATTICE. Same script, same harness, same flags, against a pristine snapshot of main (no T-009 lattice): maxX 89.3, scroll 75, 8 kills, 27.1 s, dead in gate 1. The script fails on both trees; the lattice tree gets ~1.7x further. What stops it is the gate FIGHT — a reflex policy with no aim model against diving wasps in three lanes — not the geometry: the same policy driven through the sim with hostiles removed (tools/pathcheck.mjs, 'T-009: the run reaches the outro scroll end') crosses every face and every pocket chasm and reaches the outro with 2 lives. Use this script as the traversal+pressure smoke test it is. Proving boot-to-VICTORY is deliberately NOT this script's job and was split out of T-009 into its own task (T-018) by the integrator; do not retune waves or weaken pockets to move this number.
